title: Exponential and logarithmic equations and a single logarithm
intro: No calculator. Give exact values and show the work that leads to each answer.

parts.label: A(i)

rubric.point: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \frac{1 + \ln 7}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>, with the power isolated before taking <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ln</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>14</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2e^{3x - 1} = 14</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">e^{3x - 1} = 7</annotation></semantics></math>. Then <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3x - 1 = \ln 7</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \frac{1 + \ln 7}{3}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: A(ii)
parts.prompt: Solve log2⁡x+log2⁡(x+6)\log_2 x + \log_2(x + 6)=4= 4 for xx.

rubric.point: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 2</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -8</annotation></semantics></math> rejected because <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2(-8)</annotation></semantics></math> is undefined
accept: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(x + 6) = 16</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(x + 8)(x - 2) = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 2</annotation></semantics></math> (<math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -8</annotation></semantics></math> is extraneous)

parts.sample: Product property: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2(x(x + 6)) = 4</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^2 + 6x = 16</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(x + 8)(x - 2) = 0</annotation></semantics></math>. <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -8</annotation></semantics></math> makes <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2 x</annotation></semantics></math> undefined, so it is extraneous. The solution is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 2</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: B(i)
parts.prompt: Rewrite 2ln⁡(x+1)−ln⁡x+3ln⁡22\ln(x + 1) - \ln x + 3\ln 2 as a single natural logarithm, for x>0x > 0.
parts.sample: Power property: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ln(x + 1)^2 - \ln x + \ln 8</annotation></semantics></math>. Product and quotient: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mi>x</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\ln \frac{8(x + 1)^2}{x}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: B(ii)
parts.prompt: Rewrite 9x⋅32−x9^x \cdot 3^{2 - x} as a single power of 33.
parts.sample: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">9^x = (3^2)^x = 3^{2x}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mn>9</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><mo>⋅</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">9^x \cdot 3^{2 - x}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3^{2x + 2 - x}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><msup><mn>3</mn><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 3^{x + 2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: C

rubric.point: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≤</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2(x + 1) \le 2</annotation></semantics></math> leads to <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x + 1 \le 4</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>

The domain condition <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>></mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x > -1</annotation></semantics></math> included: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo><</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-1 < x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-1, 3]</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≥</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\log_2(x + 1) \ge -2</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>≤</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2(x + 1) \le 2</annotation></semantics></math>. Since <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>log</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\log_2</annotation></semantics></math> is increasing, <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>≤</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x + 1 \le 4</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>. The logarithm also needs <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x + 1 > 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>></mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x > -1</annotation></semantics></math>. The solution is <math class="pcalc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo><</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-1 < x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>.
